description: This file defines the VisitSearchCriteriaBuilder class, which provides a fluent interface for constructing instances of VisitSearchCriteria with various filtering options for searching visits in the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: VisitSearchCriteriaBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of VisitSearchCriteria, allowing flexible creation with various filtering options.

methods.name: VisitSearchCriteriaBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the builder.

methods.name: visitTypes
methods.description: Sets the collection of VisitType objects to include in the search criteria.

methods.name: patients
methods.description: Sets the collection of Patient objects to include in the search criteria.

methods.name: patient
methods.description: Sets a single Patient object as the patient to include in the search criteria.

methods.name: locations
methods.description: Sets the collection of Location objects to include in the search criteria.

methods.name: indications
methods.description: Sets the collection of Concept objects representing indications to include in the search criteria.

methods.name: minStartDatetime
methods.description: Sets the minimum start Date for the visit search.

methods.name: maxStartDatetime
methods.description: Sets the maximum start Date for the visit search.

methods.name: minEndDatetime
methods.description: Sets the minimum end Date for the visit search.

methods.name: maxEndDatetime
methods.description: Sets the maximum end Date for the visit search.

methods.name: serializedAttributeValues
methods.description: Sets the map of serialized attribute values for filtering visits.

methods.name: includeInactive
methods.description: Determines whether inactive visits are included.

methods.name: includeVoided
methods.description: Determines whether voided visits are included.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a VisitSearchCriteria object based on the current builder state.
